# Toolchain labels encode platform and version independently of stable aliases

The corrected 1384 Linux and Windows tasks fetch their matching raw compiler labels and matching-version compiler runtimes, while stable aliases remain linux64-clang and win64-clang. At the accepted revision the same structure names version 22, so clang 19 is historical. In this Taskcluster family, recommend checking the platform/version in dependencies as well as the alias used by consumers; a version rename alone can leave a wrong-platform source. This is scoped infrastructure naming guidance, not proof of a built compiler. No test, build or runtime operation was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is pending; source landing alone does not establish reviewer approval.

Scope: Clang task dependency naming.
